extra.final_summary: The data had three issues: (1) 'dream' in the 'island' column was a lowercase variant of 'Dream' and was normalized; (2) two exact duplicate rows (5 and 21) were removed; (3) three rows with body_mass_g values far exceeding the maximum of 6,500g (5,200,000g, 5,800,000g, 3,650,000g) were excluded as likely data entry errors. After fixes, the average bill length for Adelie penguins was calculated as: Biscoe: 39.61 mm, Dream: 38.17 mm, Torgersen: 40.05 mm.
